story: Apple is open sourcing Swift Build
text: Although opinions inside Apple about Swift vary, they seem to be investing in low level Swift for embedded, kernel use, and programming the “Secure Enclave” subsystem. They certainly have many opportunities to use it for headphones, AirTag, flash driver, etc, beyond the very believable but less embedded use in kernel/Secure Enclave. See also the wwdc session where they propose swift for building smart home thingies [VIDEO]
Not for much longer, replacing it with Swift is one of the reasons why Swift Embedded subset came to be. "Why Embedded Swift" [VIDEO]
